camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyDefenseSceneConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigValue true --ConfigKey autoEnableStatus --InstanceId 'waf-cn-0xldbqt0000' --DefenseScene apisec --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Modifies the mitigation settings for a protection scenario
description_zh: 修改用户防护场景的防护配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-scene-config --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --defense-scene apisec --config-key autoEnableStatus --config-value true --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseSceneConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protection scenario for which you want to modify the mitigation settings. Valid values:

apisec: API security
parameters.help_zh:
待修改防护配置的防护场景。取值：

apisec：表示API安全
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en:
The name of the configuration item to modify.

If DefenseScene is set to apisec, the valid value is:

autoEnabled: indicates whether core API security detection is automatically enabled for new resources
parameters.help_zh:
待修改配置项的配置名称。

当防护场景 DefenseScene 为 apisec 时，取值：
autoEnabled：表示新增防护资源是否自动开启API安全核心检测
parameters.name: config_key

parameters.help_en:
The value to set for the configuration item.

The value of this parameter depends on the value of ConfigKey. For more information, see Description of mitigation setting parameters
parameters.help_zh:
待修改配置项的取值。

根据所指定的配置项名称 ConfigKey 不同，具体涉及的参数有所不同。详细信息，请参见防护配置参数描述
parameters.name: config_value
